title: The Investor

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Hello. I should thank you twice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello. I should thank you twice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Twice? How's that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Twice? How's that?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: You chose not to invest in Ashwin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You chose not to invest in Ashwin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: He told me about his dream.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He told me about his dream.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Restaurant Hygiene Tech. You're his investor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech. You're his investor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech. You're his investor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech. You're his investor?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I put my savings into his company and it paid off handsomely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I put my savings into his company and it paid off handsomely.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. When you let him down, you gave me the opportunity.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. When you let him down, you gave me the opportunity.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Ashwin sends his greetings. Goodbye.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ashwin sends his greetings. Goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Hello.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I have a license for a restaurant, as you know. And I wanted to ask you, if you'd like to have it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a license for a restaurant, as you know. And I wanted to ask you, if you'd like to have it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Oh, it's for free. It's a thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, it's for free. It's a thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: For what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For what?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Let's say... for Ashwin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's say... for Ashwin.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Now, do you want that old business license I no longer need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now, do you want that old business license I no longer need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, I don't think so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, I don't think so.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure, I'll take it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure, I'll take it.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Hello. Do you have any more information for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello. Do you have any more information for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, not really. I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not really. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Yes... I guess some stories never really end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... I guess some stories never really end.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess so.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Hello.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hello.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How can I help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How can I help?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I just wanted to thank you. And I have a gift to offer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just wanted to thank you. And I have a gift to offer.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I got to talking with a young man. He told me about his dream...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I got to talking with a young man. He told me about his dream...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Restaurant Hygiene Tech? You're Ashwin's new investor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech? You're Ashwin's new investor?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech? You're Ashwin's new investor?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Restaurant Hygiene Tech? You're Ashwin's new investor?

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: I had a little money saved. My investment in his company paid off. We both made a lot of money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I had a little money saved. My investment in his company paid off. We both made a lot of money.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. You changed my life when you withdrew your support for him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So I thought it's only fair to thank you again. You changed my life when you withdrew your support for him.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: Now, I have a license for a bar I don't intend to keep. So I'd like to gift to you that license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now, I have a license for a bar I don't intend to keep. So I'd like to gift to you that license.

nodes.speaker: Bonaventure
nodes.text: If you want it, that is?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you want it, that is?
